rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
En(H) = −13.6 Z²/n² eV
hν = ΔE
λ = h/(mv) (de Broglie)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Atom — Bohr's model" as one blob → ✅ split into: atom — bohr's model, hydrogen spectrum.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Bohr model: electron in fixed circular orbits; angular momentum mvr = nh/2π; energy En = −13.6 eV·Z²/n² (for H, Z=1).  ·  Rydberg/Balmer series: 1/λ = R(H)(1/n₁² − 1/n₂²). Absorption/emission = ΔE = hν between levels.
